newsitem.title: FRANCE: PARIS AIR CARGO GROUP TO MEET SEPT 16.
newsitem.headline: PARIS AIR CARGO GROUP TO MEET SEPT 16.

text.p: The executive committee of the Comite Interprofessionel du Fret (CIF), a steering group set up by the air cargo community at the Paris airports, Charles de Gaulle and Orly, will hold its next meeting on September 16, a CIF spokeswoman told Reuters.

CIF's executve committee comprises representatives from France's air freight forwarding agents (SNAGFA), the French shippers association (AUTF), airlines, customs and the Paris airport authority's (ADP) freight marketing department.
